description:
Discover the perfect blend of comfort and privacy in this inviting top-floor condo located in the secure, gated Collinwood community. With no neighbors above you, Unit #F30 features a spacious, open layout that maximizes natural light throughout the living and dining areas. The master bedroom offers a quiet retreat with an impressively large walk-in closet, while the kitchen includes a rare, deep walk-in pantry for endless storage. Best of all, you can enjoy peaceful views of the pool, mature trees and beautifully landscaped grounds.

This beautifully maintained community offers fantastic amenities, giving you access to three pools, two spas, outdoor BBQ areas, a playground, and a private clubhouse. The monthly HOA fee provides incredible monthly savings, fully covering your high-speed internet, cable TV, earthquake insurance, water, trash, and sewer. Located just a short distance from the popular dining, shopping, and cafes along Ventura Boulevard with quick access to the 101 Freeway, this move-in ready home offers unbeatable value and convenience!
